page.layout: One page of text. Above the text, two engraved medallions with inscriptions (left: DEMOSTHENES; right: LAIS CORIN...). Below them, the running text in one column, no margin notes, no footnotes.

main_text.p: DEMOSTHENES orator facundissimus, clarebat circa annum mundi 3615. ante Christum natum 347.hic patrem habuit gladiorum fabrum, satis opulentum, qui obiit, filium relinquens septennem: patrimonium a tutoribus male administratum, dum in iudicio repetit Demosthenes, dumque in causa propria disertus esse studet, etiam in alienis causis disertus esse discit. Nec mens eius primum satis poterat intelligi, cum lingua,vocéque laboraret:verùm studio ac exercitatione incredibili, actionem hanc ingratam in suauissimam commutauit. Dubium fuit ingenio plúsne an doctrina valuerit. plus olei quàm vini consumpsisse dictus est.Sæpe duos vel tres menses continuos non cessabat motum corporis fingere, vocem exercitare, chartis impallescere, abrasa etiam parte capitis, ut exeundi facultatem sibiipsi præriperet. Propositum eius in republ. maximè fuit, omnibus Philippi Macedoniæ regis conatibus obsistere. hoc etiam autore ciuitates Græciæ post mortem Philippi conspirauere. postea exulauit,sub obitum Alexandri, cuius cognita morte, rursus ciuitates Græciæ conspirauerunt, Antipatro in Lamia urbe a Leosthene fortiter obsesso. Tandem accersitus ab Antipatro per nuntium Archiam Tragœdum,qui identidem repetebat, fore ut ab eo humanissimè susciperetur, venenum è calamo haufit. Plutar.in Demost.Iuuena.Saty.10.

LAIS, meretrix fuit nobilis,Corynthi habitans,quam Demosthenes clanculum adiit,hac autem noctis pretium 10000. drachmarũ petente,discedens Demosthenes, Pœnitere (inquit) tanti non emo. Gel.lib.1.cap.8.Macro.in Satur.lib.2.

page.notes: Two woodcut medallions (portrait heads in profile) stand above the text; they are engravings and are not transcribed beyond their inscriptions. The right legend is partly cut off at the edge; "CORIN" is read as printed, with [?] for the possibly missing "TH". Long s has been rendered as s throughout; u/v and i/j normalised as instructed. The numerals in the text are printed with spaces between digits (e.g. "3 6 1 5", "1 0 0 0 0"); they have been written without spaces. No catchword, signature or margin notes are present.
